Population criteria

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_has.Rd

Criteria are population predicates evaluated per person or per episode with three-valued logic: a criterion over an undefined window (a required anchor is missing) is UNKNOWN for every quantifier, UNKNOWN propagates through omop_not/omop_all/omop_any, and only TRUE survives the population boundary.

Usage

omop_has(
  event,
  n = 1L,
  op = ">=",
  window = NULL,
  distinct = c("row", "day", "visit", "concept")
)

omop_has_not(event, window = NULL, nonmissing = NULL)

omop_count_is(
  event,
  op,
  n,
  window = NULL,
  distinct = c("row", "day", "visit", "concept")
)

omop_not(criterion)

omop_all(...)

omop_any(...)

omop_person(where)

omop_age_is(min = NULL, max = NULL, reference = "index", year = NULL)

omop_observed(before = NULL, after = NULL, gap = NULL)

omop_in_cohort(cohort_definition_id)

Arguments

event

An omop_event, an omop_era or a registry name.

n

Count threshold (c(min, max) for between).

op

Comparison: ">=", "<=", "==" or "between".

window

NULL (any time) or an omop_window.

distinct

What to count: "row", "day", "visit" or "concept".

nonmissing

NULL or a column that must be non-null.

criterion

A criterion.

...

Criteria to combine.

where

A predicate from omop_where.

min, max

Age bounds (inclusive; NULL = open).

reference

"index".

year

Optional fixed reference year (instead of the index).

before, after

Required observed days before/after the index.

gap

NULL or tolerated unobserved days between records.

cohort_definition_id

A results-cohort definition ID.

Value

An omop_criterion object.

Details

  • omop_has(event, n, op, window, distinct): at least n (or op n) rows of the event in the window; distinct counts rows, distinct days, visits (NULL visit keys ignored) or concepts.

  • omop_has_not(event, window, nonmissing): no row (or, with nonmissing = "value_as_number", no row with a non-null value).

  • omop_count_is(event, op, n, window, distinct): a count comparison; op = "between" takes n = c(min, max).

  • omop_not, omop_all, omop_any: logic.

  • omop_person(where): a person-table predicate (birth components may be referenced directly).

  • omop_age_is(min, max, reference, year): annual age (reference year minus year of birth) at the index (or in year).

  • omop_observed(before, after, gap): observation coverage of at least before days before and after days after the index (gap tolerates unobserved days between records).

  • omop_in_cohort(cohort_definition_id): membership of a results cohort.

Examples

omop_all(omop_observed(before = 365),
         omop_has_not(omop_event("drug_exposure", 1503297), window = omop_window(-365, -1)))
